rationale: The expression is internally coherent (ib − oancf + dp does back out the depreciation charge to leave working-capital accruals, and the non-negative leverage/retained-earnings intensity preserves the negative sign), but it sits very close to the published Sloan accrual anomaly plus the well-documented result that accrual mispricing concentrates in distressed/constrained firms, so it is a sensible baseline rather than a discovery.

Accrual volatility is essentially the Dechow–Dichev earnings-quality construct and the direction is standard, but conditioning it on earnings-to-liabilities coverage is a defensible information-risk-meets-default-risk test; watch that both legs are non-negative (so the composite has no sign variation) and that the 5-year window plus annual data does not shrink coverage into a survivor-tilted sample.

The sign convention on recch/invch is handled correctly and the sales deflator matches the channel-stuffing story, giving a genuinely informative decomposition against the aggregate-accrual version, though recch/invch have materially weaker Compustat coverage and sales-scaled ratios are unstable for low-revenue firms, so coverage and outlier control must be checked before believing any improvement.

The expected sign fights the mechanics of the expression — an increase in taxes payable is an increase in an operating liability, which *lowers* accruals and should predict higher returns under the very accrual channel the rest of the batch relies on — and the "hidden liquidity claim" story is weak because deferred cash taxes are a cheap financing source; combined with txp's spotty reporting, this is internally inconsistent rather than novel.

Economically this is the same accrual × distress content as Signal 1 with only the aggregation operator changed, and MIN discards all information in the non-binding leg, so it will be highly correlated with the product version while testing a functional-form question that is secondary to the mechanism itself.

This is the most economically distinct proposal in the batch and the sign flip is correctly specified, but ΔDP/AT is heavily contaminated by asset growth and asset-sale composition effects (so a positive result may just be re-labelled asset-growth anomaly rather than depreciation manipulation), which the follow-up should control for explicitly.
